mcqs.question: The clinical finding of localized tenderness at McBurney's point with guarding in the right iliac fossa is characteristic of:
mcqs.explanation: McBurney's point lies at the junction of the lateral third and medial two-thirds of the spinoumbilical line; maximal tenderness indicates acute inflammation of the vermiform appendix.
